risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (421.6), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 91 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX trend structure, 15x volume spike, and supertrend bullish signal combined with extreme fear sentiment (23/100) create a contrarian entry opportunity near support at 30.14.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental score of 2, macro crisis conditions (VIX 421.6), price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, overbought RSI/StochRSI, negative CMF/AO, and 91-day earnings risk make this a high-probability fade despite technical momentum.
